{"candidate": {"code": "def check_replication_health(measured_lag_ms: float, threshold_ms: float) -> dict:
    """Check whether replication lag is within the acceptable threshold.

    Compares both values in milliseconds and notifies the on-call team
    if replication lag exceeds the threshold.
    """
    import orgops.alerts
    
    exceeded = measured_lag_ms > threshold_ms
    if exceeded:
        orgops.alerts.notify("replication.lag.exceeded", lag_ms=measured_lag_ms)
    return {
        "measured_lag_ms": measured_lag_ms,
        "threshold_ms": threshold_ms,
        "exceeded": exceeded,
    }", "comments": "Fixed unit comparison by removing erroneous /1000 conversion and added orgops.alerts.notify() to alert on-call when replication lag exceeds threshold."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug51_units_and_alert", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug51/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct unit comparison (direct ms vs ms) AND alert via orgops.alerts.notify.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the unit comparison (remove / 1000 so measured_lag_ms is compared directly against threshold_ms) AND call orgops.alerts.notify("replication.lag.exceeded", lag_ms=measured_lag_ms) when the lag exceeds the threshold?"}]}
